ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with a high-intensity (white) pixel distribution ratio of approximately 3:1 across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-contrast mottling consisting of small, circular white blobs (approx. 5-20 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes, with higher spatial density on the distal third of each lobe; a contiguous low-intensity black band remains at the central median line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 15% into the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge; irregular jagged peaks are localized on the outer 20% of both the left and right lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the upper margin, tapering to sharp, slightly recurved tips at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels distributed across the mid-to-outer ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the right lobe's trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical linear pixel disruption (white) on the inner right lobe proximal to the median notch; no other significant unaligned linear marks detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable yellow-orange pixel discoloration clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, contrasting with the primary black/white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'star-field' density pattern of white spotting that is non-symmetrical between the left and right lobes.
